::: {#sol-twice-nested}

In `(twice add-three (twice add-three 0))`, the inner call `(twice add-three 0)` returns 6,
so the whole [expression](#def-racket-expression) is `(twice add-three 6)`,
which returns 12.

Racket returns the same value:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(twice add-three (twice add-three 0))
```

:::
